name: AZ Radial Image Ring Gallery for Elementor
author: azinvent

sections.description:
AZ Radial Image Ring Gallery for Elementor is a lightweight and flexible Elementor widget that allows you to display images in circular radial layouts.

Images are automatically clipped into perfect circles and distributed evenly around one or more rings surrounding a center image. The widget supports rotation, hover effects, captions, and custom links — all powered by CSS for maximum performance.

This plugin requires Elementor to be installed and activated. This plugin works with Elementor Free and does not require Elementor Pro.

Features

  • Center image with custom size, optional caption, link, and rotation direction
  • Unlimited image rings with automatic circular spacing
  • Per-ring control of radius, image size, and rotation direction
  • Clickable center and ring images (custom URLs)
  • Hover captions (from Media Library captions)
  • Hover scale effects for center and ring images
  • Pause rotation on hover (optional)
  • CSS-based frontend animation (no JavaScript required for display)
  • Responsive and mobile-friendly

Usage

Center Image

  • Choose an image
  • Set size (px)
  • Optional caption (shown on hover)
  • Optional link (URL)
  • Optional rotation direction

Rings

For each ring:
1. Add a ring
2. Select images via the Gallery picker
3. Set radius and image size
4. Choose rotation direction
5. Optional image links (one URL per line, matching image order)

Settings

  • Rotation speed (seconds)
  • Pause rotation on hover
  • Hover scale for center and ring images
  • Toggle hover captions

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Edit any page with Elementor
  4. Search for Radial Image Ring
  5. Drag the widget into your layout
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated.

Does this require Elementor Pro?

No. This plugin works with Elementor Free.

Can each ring rotate in a different direction?

Yes. Each ring can rotate clockwise, counter-clockwise, or remain static.

Are images automatically cropped into circles?

Yes. All images are displayed as perfect circles regardless of their original shape.

Can each image link to a different URL?

Yes. Both the center image and ring images support custom links.
